name: LIENHOE

notable: DR TEOH KIM LOON 于 2026-11-10 卸任董事职务，并同时退出审计、提名及薪酬委员会。
公司于 2026-10-13 发布清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理人公告。
公司于 2026-10-14 披露重大诉讼事项。
risks: 公司出现清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理人相关公告，需留意后续进展。
公司涉及重大诉讼，需关注诉讼结果及潜在影响。

recent_en: LIENHOE recently saw board and committee changes, with DR TEOH KIM LOON ceasing to be a director and member of the audit, nomination and remuneration committees on 2026-11-10. The company also disclosed a winding up/receiver/restraining order/special administrator announcement and a material litigation matter. The latest quarterly results for the period ended 30/09/2025 have been released.
notable_en: DR TEOH KIM LOON ceased to be a director and simultaneously left the audit, nomination and remuneration committees on 2026-11-10.
The company issued a winding up/receiver/restraining order/special administrator announcement on 2026-10-13.
The company disclosed a material litigation matter on 2026-10-14.
risks_en: The company has made a winding up/receiver/restraining order/special administrator related announcement; subsequent developments warrant attention.
The company is involved in material litigation; the outcome and potential impact warrant attention.
